title: Brother and Sister Reunion
next_chapter_hook: Where does the prophecy revealed by the Tianji Record point? The secret of the convergence of three bloodlines seems even Mo Xiansheng never mentioned...

text.content: Chen Nian's voice was pressed extremely low, barely above a whisper, yet every word pierced into Chen Ji's ears like an ice awl—"I am not your sister." Ye Qing's hand tightened abruptly, demonic path mist swirling around her, yet separated by some force, unable to approach Chen Nian at all. Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently as he stared at this face that overlapped with the one buried deep in his memories—ten years, he had searched for her for ten years.

"I remember, when the time is right." These four words were Chen Ji's only thought at the moment, his expression betraying nothing. Yet in the next instant, a sharp sword aura broke through the air, cleaving Ye Qing's mist apart! Chen Ji's heart clenched, and in his peripheral vision, a figure in cyan robes flashed past like a startled swan, sword light like silk, directly targeting Chen Nian's throat—"Who dares touch my brother, seeking death!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ling?! How did you—Chen Ji's words hadn't finished when the cyan-robed young woman had already landed steadily before him, her sword tip still trembling faintly. She had grown much taller than ten years ago, yet her features still retained traces of childishness, now distorted with rage. "Brother, this witch is from the Holy Sect, how can you stand with her!"

Chen Ji didn't answer immediately. He simply watched quietly the familiar yet strange face before him. Ten years, she had survived under the Holy Sect's control for ten years. And he—searched for ten years, yet didn't even know who had taken her. He suddenly smiled, that smile gentle to the point of being cruel: "Little Ling, you've grown up. Being able to find this place shows the Holy Sect's education wasn't bad."

Chen Ling's eyes instantly reddened, her sword tip nearly slipping from her grip: "Brother! Do you know why they captured me? Because they said I possess the bloodline of the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' to be cultivated as a chess piece against the Tianji Record! Every day for ten years, I thought about how to escape and find—" Her voice choked, "How could you... how could you be with someone from the Holy Sect!"

A complex light flickered in Ye Qing's eyes. She stepped forward, confronting Chen Ling across the blade: "Little girl, you think the Holy Sect is your home? They raised you for ten years, just for today." She sneered, "I'm also from the Holy Sect, but look where I'm standing now?"

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze wandered among the three. His sister's fury, the Holy Sect's traitor, and Chen Nian's earth-shattering words 'I am not your sister'—these three forces now converged because of him. He suddenly sensed a burning heat in his chest, looking down, golden light faintly glowing through his collar—that was the Tianji Record Fragment shaking on its own.

Just then, an incredible scene occurred. Chen Ling and Chen Nian simultaneously clutched their hearts, as if sensing something. An antique jade pendant at Chen Ling's waist suddenly lit up, resonating with the broken jade at Chen Nian's neck—those were the tokens of the three Chen family bloodlines, relics that should have been lost with their parents' death! The three bloodline powers collided, intertwined, and resonated in the air, converging into a brilliant golden light upon Chen Ji's chest!

choice.prompt: As blood resonance occurred, the gears of three fates began to turn. Chen Ji needed to make a choice—

choices.text: Protect his sister and question Chen Nian
choices.description: Blood resonance confirms the connection between the three. Chen Nian's words must have hidden meaning. Calming his sister's emotions is the priority now.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence on Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May cause Chen Nian to become vigilant

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flashed, blocking before Chen Ling, one hand gently pressing her sword-wielding wrist, his tone gentle yet carrying undeniable force: "Little Ling, put down the sword first." He turned to look at Chen Nian, his gaze like an ancient deep well: "Chen Nian, you just said 'you are not my sister'—what do you mean by that?"

choices.text: Stop the conflict and stabilize Ye Qing
choices.description: Ye Qing is a strategic-level ally; we cannot let his sister's impulsiveness destroy the cooperation. Chen Ling can be explained later.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling may leave in a fit of anger

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand, a sword aura accurately cutting the line between Chen Ling's sword tip and Ye Qing, dissolving the imminent conflict. "We are all on the same side." His voice was not loud, yet carried a convincing steadiness: "Little Ling, Ye Qing and I have long had an agreement; she is not an enemy. As for Chen Nian—" His gaze turned to that blurry figure, "I need to hear her explain personally."

The golden light grew ever brighter, and a massive influx of unfamiliar images suddenly flooded Chen Ji's mind—this was not a future he actively窥视ed, but text manifesting on its own through the blood resonance of the Tianji Record Fragment. Those ancient, mysterious characters swam before his eyes like living things, finally condensing into a heart-stopping prophecy—

dialogue.content: Chen Nian did not avoid Chen Ji's gaze, her voice平静得近乎冷漠: "I speak the truth—I am not Chen family blood. Chen Ling is your true sister, and I..." She paused, "I was an abandoned infant捡回来 from the ruins by the Chen family parents, having no blood relation with you. But the power of Heavenly Fate Lock Key recognizes no bloodline; it chose me."

text.content: Chen Ling froze, her sword hand trembling slightly: "You... what did you say?" Her gaze wandered between Chen Nian and Chen Ji, her mind in chaos. Chen Ji simply watched Chen Nian quietly, a flash of understanding in his eyes—he should have realized long ago that Heavenly Fate Lock Key was never a bloodline inheritance, but a projection of some ancient power in this world.

choice.prompt: Blood resonance reached an unprecedented height, the text on the Tianji Record grew increasingly clear—

choices.text: Let the Tianji Record reveal the complete prophecy
choices.description: Since the Tianji Record is manifesting on its own, go with the flow. The prophecy of the convergence of three bloodlines must be completely interpreted.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption may cause backlash

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more, guiding the blood resonance power into the Tianji Record Fragment. Golden light surged violently, all three simultaneously groaned, a vast stream of information flooding into each of their minds. The Tianji Record slowly revealed the complete prophecy—"Three bloodlines converge, blood moon hangs in the sky, Heaven's Eye shall close; one bloodline survives, reincarnation never ends, eternally falling into the abyss."

choices.text: Forcefully sever and retain trump cards
choices.description: The prophecy is too dangerous; exposing it now will only attract more covetous eyes. Must first digest the known information.
choices.visible_reward: Prevent outsiders from窥视ing Heavenly Secrets

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly cut the blood resonance, the golden light suddenly收敛. He gasped heavily, cold sweat soaking his back—the fragments of the prophecy he had glimpsed were already shocking enough. Chen Ling and Chen Nian both wore pale faces, clearly having seen something too. But Chen Ji merely淡淡开口: "Today's matter ends here."

dialogue.content: Chen Ling grabbed Chen Ji's sleeve tightly, eyes full of panic: "Brother, I just saw... the blood moon, and... the Eye of Heaven? That's传说中的—" Her voice trembled, "The Holy Sect said only the host of the Tianji Record can oppose the Eye of Heaven. You... what exactly are you enduring?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer his sister's question. He simply gently patted the back of her hand, as gentle as when he哄她入睡 ten years ago. His gaze越过两女, falling toward the distant horizon, where dark clouds gathered隐约, as if something major was brewing. The prophecy line from the Tianji Record Fragment still echoed in his mind—three bloodlines converge to shatter heaven. But if after the convergence of three bloodlines, Heaven's Eye would close... what would be the price?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed lightly, that smile gentle to the point of让人心悸. "Little Ling, you came at just the right time." He released his sister's hand, turning to look at Chen Nian, "Since you say you are not Chen family blood, you have no obligation to wade through this murky water. But if you are willing to stay—" His tone平淡, yet carrying undeniable force, "From now on, you are my sister, Chen Ji, sharing Heavenly Fate and bearing karmic consequences together with them."

text.content: Ye Qing stood aside, watching this scene, an indescribable emotion welling up in her heart. This man always made the most unexpected choices at the most impossible moments. She suddenly remembered Chen Ji once said to her—"I am not using you; I am giving you a choice." Now, he gave the same choice to Chen Nian. Chen Ling gripped her sword hilt tightly, complex gaze fixed on Chen Nian. Blood resonance doesn't lie—that sense of kinship from the depths of the soul cannot be faked. She took a deep breath, slowly sheathing her sword: "... I hope you keep your word." Chen Ji smiled faintly, turning to gaze into the distance. Ye Qing, Chen Ling, Chen Nian—three figures lined up behind him. At this moment, he suddenly felt that perhaps 'playing the pig to eat the tiger' might no longer be a one-man show.
